items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the assessment
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 22 Dec 2025, sent by ordinary post. Under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a tax letter posted since 2025 counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 26 Dec 2025. That day is a public holiday (2. Weihnachtstag), so under §108 Abs. 3 AO the deemed-delivery day shifts to the next working day, Mon 29 Dec 2025. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB / §108 Abs. 1 AO the one-month Einspruch period (§355 AO) starts the next day, and under §188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on Thu 29 Jan 2026, which is an ordinary working day so no further shift applies.

items.title: 1st quarterly income-tax prepayment for 2026
